/* isry.itgcm.casemng.uneart.mapper.UnRegCaseMapper.selectBizList */ SELECT A.UNREGI_CASE_NO , C.BIZ_YR , C.BIZ_CL_SE_CD , B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO , B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM , C.SRVC_BIZ_NO , C.SRVC_BIZ_NM , C.BIZ_BGNG_YMD , C.BIZ_END_YMD , B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS ORI_SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO FROM SED110 A, SDA420 B, SDA400 C WHERE A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AND B.SRVC_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_BIZ_NO AND A.UNREGI_CASE_NO = #{UNREGI_CASE_NO} AND A.DEL_YN != 'Y'

/* isry.itgcm.casemng.uneart.mapper.UnRegCaseMapper.selectCnterBizList */ SELECT A.SGG_CNTER_SPRT_NO , C.BIZ_YR , C.BIZ_CL_SE_CD , B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO , B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM , C.SRVC_BIZ_NO , C.SRVC_BIZ_NM , C.BIZ_BGNG_YMD , C.BIZ_END_YMD , B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS ORI_SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO FROM SED130 A, SDA420 B, SDA400 C WHERE A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AND B.SRVC_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_BIZ_NO AND A.SGG_CNTER_SPRT_NO = #{SGG_CNTER_SPRT_NO} AND A.DEL_YN != 'Y'

/* isry.itgcm.casemng.uneart.mapper.UnRegCaseMapper.selectCnstnCnterInst */ SELECT A.SGG_CNTER_SPRT_NO , A.CNSTN_CNTER_INST_NO , (SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = A.CNSTN_CNTER_INST_NO) AS CNSTN_CNTER_INST_NM , B.INST_NM AS CNSTN_CNTER_INST_NN , SUBSTR(B.RGN_CD, 0,2) AS CTPV_CD , B.SGG_CD AS CNTER_SGG_CD , A.CNSTN_CNTER_INST_NO AS ORI_CNSTN_CNTER_INST_NO FROM SED140 A, SAA000 B WHERE A.CNSTN_CNTER_INST_NO = B.INST_NO AND A.DEL_YN != 'Y' AND A.SGG_CNTER_SPRT_NO = #{SGG_CNTER_SPRT_NO}

/* isry.itgcm.casemng.uneart.mapper.UnRegCaseMapper.selectExcnDetaiaBizList */ SELECT A.UNREGI_CASE_NO , B.BIZ_YR , B.BIZ_CL_SE_CD , B.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO , B.SRVC_BIZ_NM , C.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_NO , C.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_NM , C.BIZ_BGNG_YMD , C.BIZ_END_YMD , C.BGT_EXCN_AMT , C.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_CL_SE_CD FROM SED111 A, SDA430 B, SDA440 C WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.UNREGI_CASE_NO = #{UNREGI_CASE_NO} AND A.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO = B.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO AND A.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO = C.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO AND A.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_NO = C.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_NO

/* isry.itgcm.casemng.uneart.mapper.UnRegCaseMapper.selectCnterExcnDetaiaBizList */ SELECT A.SGG_CNTER_SPRT_NO , B.BIZ_YR , B.BIZ_CL_SE_CD , B.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO , B.SRVC_BIZ_NM , C.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_NO , C.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_NM , C.BIZ_BGNG_YMD , C.BIZ_END_YMD , C.BGT_EXCN_AMT , C.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_CL_SE_CD FROM SED122 A, SDA430 B, SDA440 C WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND A.SGG_CNTER_SPRT_NO = #{SGG_CNTER_SPRT_NO} AND A.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO = B.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO AND A.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO = C.EXCN_SRVC_BIZ_CL_NO AND A.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_NO = C.EXCN_SRVC_DETAIA_BIZ_NO

/* isry.itgcm.casemng.uneart.mapper.UnRegCaseMapper.selectUnRegCasePic */ SELECT A.UNREGI_CASE_NO , A.UNREGI_CASE_PIC_NO , C##RG.DEC_B64(B.FLNM_ENCPT) AS PIC_NM_ENCPT , B.OGDP_INST_NO AS PIC_INST_NO , C.INST_NM AS PIC_INST_NM , A.PCHPRS_YN FROM SED102 A, SCA100 B, SAA000 C WHERE UNREGI_CASE_NO = #{UNREGI_CASE_NO} AND A.UNREGI_CASE_PIC_NO = B.ENFSN_NO AND B.OGDP_INST_NO = C.INST_NO AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'

/* isry.itgcm.casemng.uneart.mapper.UnRegCaseMapper.selectUnRegCaseTrpr */ SELECT /* isry.itgcm.casemng.uneart.mapper.UnRegCaseMapper.selectUnRegCaseTrpr(사례대상자목록조회) */ T1.TRPR_INFO_NO AS TRPR_INFO_NO -- 대상자정보번호 , C##RG.DEC_B64(T1.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM -- 대상자명 , T1.TRPR_BRTH_YMD AS TRPR_BRTH_YMD -- 대상자출생일자 , T1.SXDC_SE_CD AS SXDC_SE_CD -- 성별구분코드 , T1.CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD AS CASE_TRPR_SLCTN_YMD -- 사례대상자선정일자 , T2.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO -- 사례관리번호 , T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO -- 사례관리차수 , T2.CASE_BGNG_YMD AS CASE_BGNG_YMD -- 사례시작일자 , T2.CASE_TRMN_YMD AS CASE_TRMN_YMD -- 사례종결일자 , T2.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD AS UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD -- 단위업무구분코드 , T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD -- 사례진행상태구분코드 , (SELECT UP_CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T2.CASE_PRGRS_STTS_SE_CD) AS CASE_PRGRS_STTS_TYPE_SE_CD -- 사례진행상태유형구분코드 , T3.CASE_PIC_NO AS CASE_PIC_NO -- 사례담당자번호 ,(SELECT C##RG.DEC_B64(FLNM_ENCPT) FROM SCA100 WHERE ENFSN_NO = T3.CASE_PIC_NO) AS CASE_PIC_NM -- 사례담당자명 , T3.PIC_INST_NO AS PIC_INST_NO -- 담당자기관번호 ,(SELECT INST_NM FROM SAA000 WHERE INST_NO = T3.PIC_INST_NO) AS PIC_INST_NM -- 담당자기관명 , T4.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 , (SELECT PVSN_RESRCE_NM FROM SDA100 WHERE RESRCE_NO = T4.RESRCE_NO) AS RESRCE_NM -- 자원명 , T1.ACBG_SE_CD AS ACBG_SE_CD -- 학력구분코드 , T1.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD AS GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD -- 졸업상태구분코드 , T2.CASE_MNG_NO || T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_NO_ODRNO -- 사례관리번호차수 FROM SEA200 T1 , SEB100 T2 , SEB150 T3 , SED103 T4 WHERE T1.TRPR_INFO_NO = T2.TRPR_INFO_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = T3.CASE_MNG_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_NO = T4.CASE_MNG_NO AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T3.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T2.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = T4.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND T4.UNREGI_CASE_NO = #{UNREGI_CASE_NO} AND T3.PCHPRS_YN = 'Y' AND T4.DEL_YN != 'Y' ORDER BY T1.TRPR_INFO_NO DESC
